title: Agent scenario v2 (scenarios/*.json)
description: One agent scenario, v2 (unit B1): id, turns and must_include as in v1; expected_tools is a non-empty list of capabilities from the AGENT.md v2 vocabulary; expected_outcome is a non-empty list of typed criterion objects; success_criteria is optional and, when present, a non-empty list of typed criterion objects. A v1 scenario (tool names, string outcomes) fails. A $defs entry with a description is a message rule. Fix: write each scenario as a JSON object with id (string), turns ([{"user": ...}]), expected_tools (capabilities such as read or search), must_include (list of strings), and expected_outcome (typed criterion objects such as {"type": "no_writes"}).
$comment: source: house (scenario v2, assessment section 2.1 line 154 and section 4.4 line 358, agent-master-skills.md:149, plan.md:778; no dated record); severity: fail (the scenarios-valid row, must); protects: claude, codex, opencode, hermes. The criterion definitions are copied from schemas/agent-frontmatter.schema.json and pinned equal by tests/test_typed_criteria.py.

scenario-object.description: scenario must be a JSON object, got %(type)s

expected-tools.description: expected_tools: non-empty list of capabilities (read, search, write, shell, web_fetch, web_search, delegate, skill) required

must-include.description: must_include: non-empty list of strings required

expected-outcome-list.description: expected_outcome: non-empty list of typed criterion objects required

outcome-item.description: expected_outcome[%(i)s]: %(error)s (a criterion is one typed object: min_verified_sources, file_line_citations, no_writes, max_chars, markdown_table or llm)

success-criteria-list.description: success_criteria: non-empty list of typed criterion objects required when present

criteria-item.description: success_criteria[%(i)s]: %(error)s (a criterion is one typed object: min_verified_sources, file_line_citations, no_writes, max_chars, markdown_table or llm)
